scope: Four new bounded Pancake V3 position-manager multicall roots on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum and Monad only. Existing BSC root and every existing scope remain untouched. No new execution language, runtime, profiles, grants or child admissions.

v2.testnetDecision: Excluded BSC Testnet router 0xd99d1c33f9fc3444f8101754abc46c52416550d1; testnets and unsupported chains are outside existing-chain production scope.

pinnedCorroboration.scope: Pinned repository artifacts corroborate BSC/Ethereum addresses only; other chains use current official map and their own verifier.

v3.testnetDecision: BSC TESTNET column is not BSC mainnet: manager 0x427bf5b37357632377ecbec9de3626c71a5396c1 and same-address testnet SwapRouter are excluded.

excludedExecutorFamilies.decision: No SmartRouter/UniversalRouter capability, opaque execute or unconstrained multicall admitted. No existing Uniswap executor scope is reused for Pancake.

officialMaps.nonEvmDecision: Aptos is outside this EVM assignment and receives no mapping inference or capabilities.

hashRecipes.documentPool: SHA-256 of exact HTTP response body bytes; content preserves UTF-8 raw provider JSON/HTML rather than a tool wrapper representation. Raw Sourcify all-fields documents preserve full provider data, verification metadata, source bodies and bytecode; target sourceFiles additionally reference extracted content-addressed sourcePool.
hashRecipes.sourcePool: SHA-256 of exact UTF-8 Solidity source content with no normalization. Every target sourceFiles map retains its own provider file names, even when content is pooled.
hashRecipes.fullAbiSha256: SHA-256 of recursively key-sorted JSON full ABI, compact separators, array order preserved.
hashRecipes.abiHash: Keccak-256 of recursively key-sorted normalized capability ABI JSON, compact separators, array order preserved; normalized fragments omit internalType/legacy redundant fields only.
hashRecipes.selector: First four Keccak-256 bytes of full canonical signature, including tuples/array suffixes.

lineage.retention: Exact independently bound per-target ABI/deployment/source records retained below; raw verifier/explorer documents and complete ABI inventories remain in the named lineage file. Source pool keys are retained SHA256 content identities, not capability ABI hashes.

executionReview.abiHashRecipe: Actual src/modules/defi/registry/defi-manifest.ts functionAbiHash on each fresh catalog child: Keccak-256 of recursively key-sorted JSON ABI array, not SHA256.
warnings: Bounded self-delegatecall only: exactly eight independently admitted same-chain/address child identities. No nested multicall, createPool, NFT transfer, approval, permit or standalone callback children.
Self-delegatecall preserves original msg.sender, msg.value, address(this) and storage. The same outer native value is visible to every child, not a fresh per-child payment or allocated budget.

Native balance can fund wrapping; otherwise pay uses manager custody or caller ERC20 transferFrom. Send only intended native value and explicitly refund residual native funds; payable does not guarantee automatic refunds.

unwrapWETH9 and sweepToken transfer entire manager balances, not per-caller escrow; refundETH sends entire native balance to original caller. Zero collect recipient retains manager custody. Ordered child calls may leave assets in public custody.
NFT authorization, caller-selected recipient, token pair, fee, ticks, minimums, deadline and existing token approvals remain independent responsibilities. increaseLiquidity is third-party fundable.
Root and each child require independent grants and pause checks. Existing canonical ABI/native-value checks, execution node limits and final authorization rechecks remain unchanged.
Source admission is not fresh bytecode identity, balances, liquidity, funding, successful execution, financial safety or complete-workflow attestation.

abiEvidence.independentBinding: Own exact-chain/address verifier response, never another deployment ABI.

sourceSemantics.poolDerivation: Immutable deployer and reviewed PoolAddress init-code hash derive token0/token1/fee pools; pool callbacks validate sender against derived pool. Callback ABI remains excluded as standalone user capability.
sourceSemantics.custody: Zero swap/collect recipient means self custody. Settlement helpers sweep entire public contract balances, not per-caller escrow. Refund is full native balance to msg.sender.
sourceSemantics.native: pay uses existing native balance to wrap WETH9 when sufficient, otherwise contract token custody or caller ERC20 transferFrom. Payable does not mean arbitrary native deposits will be refunded.
sourceSemantics.nft: Manager uses NFT-owner/existing-approved-operator authorization for decrease/collect/burn and transfers, but increaseLiquidity is third-party fundable. Empty-data safeTransferFrom invokes fixed receiver callback; opaque four-argument payload remains excluded.

previousMulticallDecision.reason: Opaque bytes[] self-delegatecall executor. Only already-existing BSC NPM bounded multicall is preserved; no new chain/address execution scope or child-binding migration is admitted in this catalog-only increment.

review.body: Inherited public payable multicall(bytes[]) allocates results and loops in order over data; each item uses address(this).delegatecall(data[i]). Failed children revert the entire operation (short revert data reverts empty; otherwise Error(string) is decoded); successful result bytes are retained. No arbitrary target, external executor, child value allocation or forwarding call exists in this body.
review.inheritance: Exact-target manager source imports and inherits Multicall; source-bound IMulticall ABI and concrete body agree. No multicall override in reviewed manager source.
review.identity: Every allowed child is resolved from the fresh catalog at this exact chain/address; ABI hashes computed by actual repository functionAbiHash via node + ts-node/register/transpile-only. No cross-target ABI substitution.
review.limitations: Provider grades retained without promotion; not a fresh runtime or execution check.
